visual_synopsis: A young man in a white undershirt lounges in bed with his wife, who brings him coffee in a red cup, until a mustachioed man in a light denim jacket turns up at the flat's front door and is let in. The guest strips off his jacket, settles onto the second bed and keeps talking, while the husband ends up sprawled on the rag rug beside the bed with his hand over his face, visibly worn out.
